title: CrowdStrike buys identity management startup SGNL, in a deal valued at nearly $740M, to bolster identity security defenses on its flagship Falcon platform (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
summary: Samantha Subin / CNBC: CrowdStrike buys identity management startup SGNL, in a deal valued at nearly $740M, to bolster identity security defenses on its flagship Falcon platform — CrowdStrike announced Thursday that it is buying identity management startup SGNL in a deal valued at nearly $740 million …
